newsitem.title: SPAIN: Barcelona March air cargo traffic slows to 1.75 pc.
newsitem.headline: Barcelona March air cargo traffic slows to 1.75 pc.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Spain's Barcelona airport rose only 1.75 percent in March compared with the same month in 1996, despite double digit increases in January and February, the airport authority said.
The March total of 7,139 tonnes takes the accumulated cargo volume so far this year to 21,106 tonnes, 13.7 percent more than the first quarter of 1996.

European Union freight business rose 16.4 percent to 3,135 tonnes in the month while domestic cargo volume fell 4.4 percent to 2,840 tonnes. Non-European Union international freight business fell 13.9 percent to 1,164 tonnes. -Reuter Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
